limitations: Shadow opportunities are arm-specific post-assignment states. The rule uses displayed depth that includes the maker's own orders; activity does not prove imbalance predicts external flow or a positive market effect.

claims.text: For M1 in this fixed simulated ecology, assigning gain two bps instead of zero from world start changed registered later public two-sided time by -6, -8 and +5 seconds across three paired development seeds; no consistent positive-availability response was observed.
limitations: Three development seeds provide a descriptive range, not a confidence interval, equivalence claim or confirmation. M2 slot sensitivity is not another independent seed set; endogenous counterparty paths can diverge.
